# CBADASReml

## A collection of helper functions for small-plot trial analysis using ASReml

## Installation instructions

{CBADASReml} is available through the
[R-Universe](https://aagi-aus.r-universe.dev/packages) with pre-built
binaries (this is the easy way).

To get started:

### Enable this universe

``` r

options(
    repos = c(
        AAGI = 'https://aagi-aus.r-universe.dev',
        CRAN = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'
    )
)
```

### Install

``` r

install.packages("CBADASReml")
```

### The hard(er) way

You can install {CBADASReml} directly from the repository with {pak}
like so:

``` r

o <- options() # store default options

options(pkg.build_vignettes = TRUE)

if (!require("pak")) {
    install.packages("pak")
}
pak::pak("AAGI-AUS/CBADASReml")

options(o) # reset options
```

## Usage

For a detailed understanding of how the package can be used, here is a
fully worked example of a small-plot trial analysis: [Small-Plot Case
Study](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/articles/small_plot_analysis.html)
This analysis tries to showcase each function in a useful capacity.

All contributions are appreciated, but please make sure to follow the

Guidelines](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/CONTRIBUTING.md).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`anova_table()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/anova_table.md)
  : An ANOVA table function
- [`design_efficiency()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/design_efficiency.md)
  : Calculate the design efficiency/optimality of a small-plot trial
  design
- [`design_power()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/design_power.md)
  : Calculate the statistical power for an experimental design
- [`directional_variograms()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/directional_variograms.md)
  : A Spatial Variogram Function for Single Site Data
- [`exploratory_table()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/exploratory_table.md)
  : Produces a summary table for the data with Mean, Median, SD, CV and
  Range
- [`lsd_graph()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/lsd_graph.md)
  : Create an LSD graph from an ASReml model
- [`lsd_group()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/lsd_group.md)
  : Group treatments using results of paired t-test
- [`lsd_table()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/lsd_table.md)
  : Create an LSD table from an ASReml model
- [`ofe_grid_data()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/ofe_grid_data.md)
  : Grid data ready for ASReml analysis
- [`ofe_rotate_data()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/ofe_rotate_data.md)
  : Rotate a georeferenced data frame
- [`outlier_summary()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/outlier_summary.md)
  : Detect outliers for small-plot trial analysis
- [`plot_gridded_ofe()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/plot_gridded_ofe.md)
  : Plot diagnostics of gridded OFE
- [`pred_table()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/pred_table.md)
  : Generate prediction table from model
- [`report_tables()`](https://aagi-aus.github.io/CBADASReml/reference/report_tables.md)
  : A prediction function for models with more than one variable to
  predict on
